xmldoc.short_description: Print a short human-readable summary of a WFDB record.

param_input_item.param_description: the record, with or without its .hea extension.

param_output_item.param_description: the summary as text; when no output is asked, it is printed instead.

description.p: The summary is the record name and rate, its length in frames and seconds, the start time when known, the segment count of a multi-segment record, and for every signal its label, format, gain and unit, followed by any header comments. It reads the header only, so it is cheap on a long record.
